title: Initial Balance Extension
summary: Of the sessions that broke their initial balance in the given direction, how often price extended at least r times the IB range beyond the broken side. Sessions that held inside their balance never enter the denominator — this measures what breaks became, not how often breaks happen. Ladder r for the extension curve, and read it next to the break-type table for the other half of the question.
deltas: a continuous extension ladder instead of fixed target lines
the conditional denominator (breaking sessions) is stated, not implied
N + 95% CI + stability split on every rung
